subject: Retail POC: streaming + tool-calling handoff and schema checklist
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wong <alex.wong@brightwellretail.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Retail POC: streaming + tool-calling handoff and schema checklist

Hi Alex —

Great to meet you on the call yesterday. Per our scope for the BrightWell Retail POC, I wanted to share the initial artifacts and propose the handoff cadence so we can begin implementation next week. Attached: streaming_schema_v1.json (schema sketch for structured streaming output) and tool_mapping.xlsx (proposed tool-call mappings for inventory lookups and price checks).

Quick ask: can you share a representative sample payload from your order events (or a small sanitized extract) so Camila and our implementation lead can validate field mappings?

Proposed next steps (one-liner timeline):
- This week: Camila will confirm onboarding plan and runbook; we validate schema against sample payload.
- Week 1: Implementation sprint — streaming output + tool-call integration in our sandbox.
- Week 2: Pilot run & latency checks, then plan production rollout.

CCing Camila (CS) to lead the onboarding. If you have a security contact for SOC2 evidence / procurement questions please send their email and we’ll loop them in.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0172

Attachments: streaming_schema_v1.json (application/json, 12KB), tool_mapping.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 34KB)

From: Alex Wong <alex.wong@brightwellretail.com>

Date: 2027-10-21T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retail POC: streaming + tool-calling handoff and schema checklist

Marcus — thanks for the docs and the clear plan. A couple of quick questions before we schedule the kickoff: 

1) Tool-calling latency: what p95 numbers should we expect for remote inventory lookups? Our chief architect flagged timeout risk for customer-facing flows.
2) Schema question: our product objects include nested variant arrays (colors/sizes). Does streaming_schema_v1.json support nested arrays or is there a recommended flattening pattern?

I'll attach a sanitized sample payload shortly (will send as sample_payload.json). Also forwarding this to Emma Li (security) for SOC2 evidence and procurement.

Available for a kickoff Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

—Alex
Alex Wong
Head of Engineering | BrightWell Retail

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Retail POC: streaming + tool-calling handoff and schema checklist

Hi Alex —

Nice to meet you — I’m Camila, your Customer Success lead for the POC. Thanks Marcus for the intro. I’ve attached a short onboarding handshake checklist that outlines responsibilities, deliverables, and timelines. High level plan below — I’ll own the runbook and weekly syncs.

Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — POC (3 weeks):
- Week 0 (pre-work): BrightWell provides sample_payload.json and security contact for SOC2 artifacts (Emma Li).
- Week 1 (integration): Redwood implements streaming output with structured JSON schema + wire up tool calls for inventory/price (sandbox).
- Week 2 (pilot & validation): Run sample traffic, capture latency/cost metrics, validate structured outputs against acceptance tests.
- Week 3 (wrap): Compile evaluation, playbook for production cutover.

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- Structured output conforms to agreed schema (no missing variant fields)
- Tool calls return under 200ms p95 in sandbox for sample traffic profile
- No PII leaks in streamed payloads; agreed redaction rules applied

Please find the checklist attached (onboarding_handshake_checklist.pdf) — it includes a short list of sample API payloads we need and a small set of unit tests we’ll run during validation.

Can you confirm:
- Who on your side will provide the sample payloads?
- Are there any firewall/egress restrictions we should know about for the sandbox?
- Preferred kickoff time (Marcus suggested Tue/Wed afternoon PST).

Thanks — I’ll schedule the first sync once I have your availability and the payload.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0134

Attachments: onboarding_handshake_checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)

Camila / Marcus —

Thanks — attaching the sanitized sample payload as requested (sample_payload.json). On your schema question: yes, we need to preserve nested variant arrays (product.variants) for downstream personalization; flattening would complicate joins on our side. If your schema supports nested arrays, that’s ideal.

Emma (cc) is our security engineer and will follow up with SOC2 artifacts and procurement contact info.

We can do Tue Oct 26 at 1:30pm PST for the kickoff — works for the engineering team.

—Alex

Subject: Re: Retail POC: streaming + tool-calling handoff and schema checklist

Morning team — looping in a short implementation plan and runbook summary (see bullets below). I’ll be the technical PM for this POC and will coordinate the sandbox environment, traffic replay, and latency measurements.

Implementation runbook (summary):
- Day -1: Confirm sample_payload.json fields and map to streaming_schema_v1.json; identify any missing fields and propose quick-mapping rules.
- Day 0: Provision sandbox workspace; exchange API keys and whitelist Redwood IPs.
- Day 1-3: Implement streaming endpoint + tool-call adapters (inventory, price).
- Day 4: Run synthetic traffic (10k events/hour) and capture p50/p95 latency and token costs.
- Day 5: Acceptance testing against unit tests in onboarding_handshake_checklist.pdf.

SLO targets for POC: 200ms p95 for tool-calls in sandbox; streaming event throughput 150 rps sustained with <10% error rate. If we see consistent spikes we’ll enable caching around the inventory tool calls.

I’ve uploaded our runtime guide and a short checklist to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/brightwell-poc-docs. Please confirm any IP whitelist rules and I’ll schedule a 60-minute kickoff for Tue Oct 26 1:30pm PST (calendar invite to follow).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0129
